content.text:
The migrated file is at `out/module.ts`. It type-checks with the project's strict settings and `skipLibCheck`. I couldn't run the original for a direct output comparison, because lodash isn't installed and I was told not to install anything.

`npm run size -- out/module.ts` prints 807 bytes (min+gzip) with 99 bytes of own code. I didn't measure `src/module.ts`, since its lodash imports no longer resolve here, so I have no size baseline to compare against.

- **`tokens`:** now uses `words` from `es-toolkit`. I compared it with the lodash-compatible `words` in `es-toolkit/compat` on ASCII inputs with hyphens, underscores, periods, runs of capitals and digits between letters, and the two gave identical output.
- **`byAge`:** now uses `groupBy` from `es-toolkit` with `(row) => row.age`. Number keys become strings as before. The only addition is that small `(row) => row.age` adapter.
- **`preview`:** `es-toolkit` has no `truncate`, so it uses `truncate` from `es-toolkit/compat`, which is lodash-compatible. I checked one 24-character case and got `R@7Eg0!VP.)cC.CGq&fD5...`. Importing it from a deeper path to save bytes fails to resolve, so I kept the `compat` import.

There are no lodash imports left, and the exports and signatures (`Row`, `Config`, `tokens`, `byAge`, `preview`) are unchanged.
